train_autoencoder: train a convolutional autoencoder on the nsynth dataset with configurable channels, stride, and dimension
train_sequence_generator: train a sequence generator model using precomputed audio embeddings and cardinality metadata
fine_tune_sing: fine-tune the SING model using a pre-trained sequence generator and autoencoder decoder
run_main: run the full SING training pipeline that trains autoencoder, sequence generator, and fine-tunes SING end-to-end
get_parser: get an argparse parser with CLI arguments for configuring SING training pipeline hyperparameters
